run_pipeline: run the Apache Beam pipeline to convert MiniWoB episodes to TF examples for training
create_convert_episode: create a ConvertEpisode DoFn that transforms episode steps into TF example protos with image and value targets
build_pipeline: build an Apache Beam pipeline that reads episode TFRecords and writes value-function TF examples
test_main: test the main entry point that launches the Beam pipeline with CLI flags for inputs, output_dir, and reward_threshold
review_convert_episode_process: review the ConvertEpisode.process method that filters low-reward episodes and yields per-step TF examples
